program.name: Dumbbell Conditioning
program.subject: Conditioning
program.blurb: Long dumbbell conditioning: two AMRAPs one day, two ladders the next.
program.about: Conditioning with the dumbbells in your hands the whole time. One day is two AMRAPs of thrusters, snatches, rows and lunges, as many rounds as you can; the other is two ladders of the same lifts, one rep each, then two, then three. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
